description: Source code for an Odoo report module generating an aged trial balance report, including class and method definitions, database queries, and report registration.

classes.name: aged_trial_report
classes.description: Class for generating aged trial balance report, inheriting from rml_parse.rml_parse, with methods to fetch and process account data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing report context and local variables.

methods.name: _get_lines
methods.description: Fetches partner account lines, computes balances over periods, and returns structured data for report.

methods.name: _get_total
methods.description: Returns total amount for a given period index.

methods.name: _get_direction
methods.description: Returns direction-based balance for a given period index.

methods.name: _get_for_period
methods.description: Returns balance for a specific period index.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Retrieves company name based on form data.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves company's currency name based on form data.
